Realistic-physics bike and scooter sims (wheelies, rideouts, police chases) form a growing niche that monetizes well through vehicle passes
new.rationale: Wheelie Road is today's most efficient Top Earning game; Untitled Wheelie Game, Project Bikelife and Scooter Empire all sell many bike passes and sit on Top Earning or Up-and-Coming. Confirm if more such games enter and keep efficient Top Earning positions over the next two weeks.

qualitative_updates.note: Sell Fries! [Anomaly] rose 28 places on Most Popular, is among the best on Top Trending momentum and top 3 on Up-and-Coming, a full three-chart run at 21 days old.
